1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif face with comfortable line spacing in labels, fields and banners, though letter spacing appears default rather than specially generous.

2.why: No italics or all-caps text appear anywhere, and all copy is broken into short lines and small banners rather than dense blocks.

3.why: The single-column layout fits a mobile viewport and stays readable, but by step 8 eight stacked duplicate error banners crowd and clutter the screen.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in to start your security setup' and 'Check your email and password, then try again' are short and written in plain language.

5.why: The email field shows 'Example: marcus@example.com' beneath it and the demo panel displays sample credentials.

6.why: No long text blocks appear anywhere; the longest content is the two-line demo sign-in hint.

7.why: No MFA codes or secrets are ever displayed since the flow never advances past sign-in, and no copy-to-clipboard control is visible, though the demo credentials are plain selectable text.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent scan-based alternative appears in any of the eight screens.

9.why: The hint 'Use your saved password' suggests password-manager use, but actual autofill/password-manager support cannot be confirmed from the screenshots alone.

10.why: A 'Step 1 of 4 · Sign in' indicator and a large high-contrast blue Sign in button stand out clearly, though the growing wall of error banners dilutes their prominence in later screens.

11.why: The only main action on every screen is the single 'Sign in' button; 'Need help?' is a collapsible aid, not a competing action.

12.why: Each failed attempt produces 'Check your email and password, then try again,' but identical duplicates accumulate (eight by the end) instead of one clear status update, so the feedback is not stated plainly.

13.why: Sign-in was retried eight times with no lockout or penalty shown, but no reveal/hide toggle for the password field and no code re-request option are visible.

14.why: The error states what to check (email and password) and what to do (try again) in a neutral, non-blaming tone, though it does not specify which credential failed.

15.why: No timers, countdowns, or expiring elements appear on any screen, but the code-entry step is never reached so the generosity of code-entry time cannot be confirmed.
